sources.title: Qwen2.5-Omni Technical Report
sources.authority_reason: Qwen 團隊發布的原始技術報告，直接介紹時間對齊的三軸位置表示。
sources.inspection_note: §2.2 Perceivation, Video and TMRoPE；Read the full original §2.2. Images use constant temporal IDs and distinct height/width IDs; video temporal IDs follow actual frame times at 40ms per ID; audio uses identical component position IDs. The lesson explicitly uses a different toy convention (250ms and zero spatial audio coordinates), so it does not claim equivalence to the official implementation.

sources.title: Qwen3-Omni Technical Report
sources.authority_reason: Qwen 團隊發布的原始技術報告，直接記載 TM-RoPE 的三軸與 24/20/20 交錯分配。
sources.inspection_note: §2.3 Perceivation, Video and Multimodal Position Embedding (TM-RoPE)；Read the full original §2.3. The paper states the 24/20/20 interleaving directly, uses row and column positions for visual height/width, and uses 80ms per temporal ID. Its performance rationale is not treated as an empirical result of the toy lesson.

sources.title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
sources.authority_reason: RoPE 原始論文，給出二維旋轉、分對處理與相對座標點積的原始公式。
sources.inspection_note: §3.1 Eq.(11), §3.2.1 Eq.(12)–(13), §3.2.2 Eq.(14)–(16), §3.4.2 Eq.(34)；Read the original formulae and surrounding text through pdftotext -layout: 2D rotation is [[cos,-sin],[sin,cos]], even-dimensional space is split into independent 2D blocks, and the rotated inner product depends on relative coordinates. Eq.(34) gives the equivalent pairwise arithmetic. Also inspected §4.5.5 limitations; no training claim is imported into this review.

sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.authority_reason: Transformer 原始論文，直接界定 decoder 自注意力遮罩允許的序列位置。
sources.inspection_note: §3.1 Decoder; §3.2.3 Applications of Attention in our Model, third bullet；Read the original decoder masking passages. The standard mask describes sequence positions up to and including the query. It does not assert chronological causality of physical audiovisual timestamps; the latter depends on serialization and is explicitly excluded by this lesson.

sources.details: R(theta)(a,b)=(a cos(theta)-b sin(theta),a sin(theta)+b cos(theta))；R(alpha)^T R(beta)=R(beta-alpha)。本例三對內容都為(1,0)，後兩對座標0，故 S=2+cos((t_q-t_k)*pi/4)。t=(1250,1300,2300)/250=(5,5.2,9.2)，兩個角差為pi/20與21pi/20，分數為2.9876883405951378及1.0123116594048622。q_a 時間對為(cos1.3pi,sin1.3pi)=(-0.5877852523,-0.8090169944)；改h或w為1只將對應一對轉pi/4。tags逐項計數給F5=6、F15=16、A1=20，M[i,j]=(i>=j)給row20可見0..20。F15=15*250=3750ms。unit500令三時間為2.5、2.6、4.6；分數變為2+cos(pi/40)及2+cos(21pi/40)。本例週期8時間單位，delta0/4/8的分數3/1/3反證距離與分數必定單調。完整逐項推導見a_derivation。
